limitations: Official requested-date schedules are evidence of published passenger stop sequences, not confirmation the train physically ran.
Public search endpoint caps prefix results at 200; corpus is deliberately sampled and not a national timetable inventory.
No stops were inferred from routing graphs, station order, or another train.
G383 and G386 are official public aliases of one internal service and must not be counted as independent train services.

Some source station_no values skip numbers. They are retained unchanged; full means the returned passenger stop list agrees with official search total_num and endpoints, not that station numbers or physical stations are contiguous.
